mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.description, p.owner_id, o.username AS owner_username, o.real_name AS owner_real_name, p.status, p.start_date, p.plan_end, p.actual_end, p.created_at, m.project_role AS my_role FROM project p JOIN sys_user o ON o.id = p.owner_id LEFT JOIN project_member m ON m.project_id = p.id AND m.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project (name, description, owner_id, status, start_date, plan_end) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{ownerId}, #{status}, #{startDate}, #{planEnd})
mapper.update: UPDATE project SET status = 'ARCHIVED', actual_end = #{actualEnd} WHERE id = #{id}
